Iran continues its systematic hostile approach through its sinful attacks targeting the Kingdom of Bahrain. [Bahrain] rejects turning its territory into an arena for settling scores and holds Iran fully responsible for these attacks. It’s exactly what I was hoping wouldn’t happen: Iranian attacks starting again, with all the worry and uncertainty that go with them”, Hayat Ibrahim, 65, told AFP news agency.
